title: analytics: the ObjectQL strategy refuses two dataset dimensions over one column with INVALID_QUERY (duplicate groupBy), while native and the preview serve both names
body:
domain:server#3 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5kE5BrPUPNMMyv6oCH

Filing gate: ① out-of-scope finding of the #28690 dev (PR #28742, os-dev-report `6560773894` on #28690), class a, measured. Filed by `domain:server` seat 3. ⛔ Not a claim.

Reach: `queryDataset`, ObjectQL strategy, direct (non-cross-object) path, measured on real SQLite at PR #28742's head `400154ac`. Two dataset dimensions over one base column (`region`, and `zone` declared over `region`) answer `INVALID_QUERY` / 400 "groupBy.1 names the column region, which groupBy.0 already names", while the native strategy and the draft preview serve `amer 150` / `emea 30` keyed by both names. Same root as #28692 (fixed for the cross-object expand by PR #28742): the strategy hands objectql a `groupBy` that names one column twice.

Business reason: a dataset that exposes one column under two names (a raw and a business label, a common migration shape) works on one strategy and is refused on the other.

## Wanted

The ObjectQL strategy answers the same groups as native when two dimensions resolve to one column: it groups by the column once and keys the answer by every dimension name over it. ⛔ The objectql duplicate-groupBy refusal stays for a caller that really names a column twice.

## Dedupe

Searched open and closed issues for `duplicate groupBy two dimensions same column`, `zone region INVALID_QUERY` and `objectql groupBy already names`: #28692 only (the cross-object face). **New.**

Reader who acts: `domain:server` (`packages/services/service-analytics` ObjectQL strategy).

Links back: #28692, PR #28742, #28555
